content.json:
# Monitoring Baselines - Posture Workbook

Shows compliance with the Monitoring Baselines initiative: **Azure Monitor Agent (AMA)**, **diagnostic settings**, and **private endpoint** policies. Use the non-compliant drill-down tables to identify the exact resources with monitoring or logging gaps.

> This workbook is part of the `monitoring-baselines` component and is independent of the AMBA alerting workbook.

---

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| where properties.policySetDefinitionName == '{InitiativeName}'
| extend group = tostring(properties.policyDefinitionGroupNames[0])
| extend complianceState = tostring(properties.complianceState)
| summarize Total = count(), NonCompliant = countif(complianceState == 'NonCompliant') by group
| extend CompliancePercent = round(100.0 * (Total - NonCompliant) / Total, 1)
| project Category = group, Total, NonCompliant, CompliancePercent
| order by CompliancePercent asc
content.title: Compliance % by Policy Category (AMA / Diagnostic Settings / Private Endpoints)

content.json:
## Non-Compliant Resources: Azure Monitor Agent (AMA)

Resources missing the Azure Monitor Agent extension. These will be auto-remediated by DeployIfNotExists or can be remediated on demand.

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| where properties.policySetDefinitionName == '{InitiativeName}'
| where properties.policyDefinitionGroupNames has 'azure-monitor-agent'
| where properties.complianceState == 'NonCompliant'
| extend resourceId = tostring(properties.resourceId)
| extend resourceType = tostring(properties.resourceType)
| extend subscriptionId = tostring(properties.subscriptionId)
| extend rg = tostring(properties.resourceGroup)
| extend lastEvaluated = todatetime(properties.timestamp)
| project ResourceName = tostring(split(resourceId, '/')[-1]), resourceType, rg, subscriptionId, lastEvaluated, resourceId
| order by lastEvaluated desc
content.title: Non-Compliant Resources - Missing AMA

content.json:
## Non-Compliant Resources: Diagnostic Settings

Resources not routing platform logs/metrics to the central Log Analytics workspace.

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| where properties.policySetDefinitionName == '{InitiativeName}'
| where properties.policyDefinitionGroupNames has 'diagnostic-settings'
| where properties.complianceState == 'NonCompliant'
| extend resourceId = tostring(properties.resourceId)
| extend resourceType = tostring(properties.resourceType)
| extend subscriptionId = tostring(properties.subscriptionId)
| extend rg = tostring(properties.resourceGroup)
| extend lastEvaluated = todatetime(properties.timestamp)
| project ResourceName = tostring(split(resourceId, '/')[-1]), resourceType, rg, subscriptionId, lastEvaluated, resourceId
| order by lastEvaluated desc
content.title: Non-Compliant Resources - Missing Diagnostic Settings

content.json:
## Non-Compliant Resources: Private Endpoints

Monitoring-adjacent resources not using private link (flagged when effect is Audit, blocked when effect is Deny).

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| where properties.policySetDefinitionName == '{InitiativeName}'
| where properties.policyDefinitionGroupNames has 'private-endpoints'
| where properties.complianceState == 'NonCompliant'
| extend resourceId = tostring(properties.resourceId)
| extend resourceType = tostring(properties.resourceType)
| extend subscriptionId = tostring(properties.subscriptionId)
| extend rg = tostring(properties.resourceGroup)
| extend lastEvaluated = todatetime(properties.timestamp)
| project ResourceName = tostring(split(resourceId, '/')[-1]), resourceType, rg, subscriptionId, lastEvaluated, resourceId
| order by lastEvaluated desc
content.title: Non-Compliant Resources - Missing Private Endpoint

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == 'microsoft.policyinsights/policystates'
| where properties.policySetDefinitionName == '{InitiativeName}'
| extend complianceState = tostring(properties.complianceState)
| extend evalTime = todatetime(properties.timestamp)
| summarize Total = count(), Compliant = countif(complianceState == 'Compliant') by bin(evalTime, 1d)
| extend CompliancePercent = round(100.0 * Compliant / Total, 1)
| project evalTime, CompliancePercent
| order by evalTime asc
content.title: Overall Compliance Trend

content.query:
policyresources
| where type == 'microsoft.policyinsights/remediations'
| where properties.policyAssignmentId has 'mon-baselines'
| extend remediationState = tostring(properties.provisioningState)
| extend createdOn = todatetime(properties.createdOn)
| extend resourceCount = toint(properties.deploymentStatus.totalDeployments)
| project RemediationName = name, remediationState, resourceCount, createdOn
| order by createdOn desc
content.title: Monitoring Baselines Remediation Tasks
